reuse.why: Extracts one linkBankSyncAccount core that all six provider links (Fintegra included) call, and folds Fintegra into the existing Akahu balance branch; the holder unlink still re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: The five copied link bodies are removed, but every provider wrapper calls assertBankAccountNotLinked itself and the core calls it again, the unlink reset is copied from unlinkAccount, and downloadFintegraTransactions is a near copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Link logic is centralised in accounts/app.ts with provider wrappers only mapping their data, and provider plumbing goes to server-config/sync.ts; the closed-account check is folded into a function named for the duplicate-link rule.

scope.why: Edits serve the five steps; release-note files and a new types module are routine additions.

maintainability.why: The shared core makes future link rules a one-place change, but the double guard call per link, a check function that also returns holders to mutate, and the copied unlink reset leave traps for maintainers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount clears previous holders with its own copy of unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount reset rather than a shared helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated guard calls, the unlink reset and the Fintegra download are written openly in the same shape as their originals.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked grows a replaceExistingLink flag and an unrelated closed-account branch and now returns holders for the caller to unlink; linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and the holder-clearing loop; each of the six provider wrappers repeats the guard call before the core repeats it again.
